title: Module manifest
description: Contract a forge module declares at its root as module.json. The orchestrator discovers modules by scanning submodules for this file.

type.description: claude (default): slash command run headlessly via claude -p. exec: deterministic command run directly in the module directory, project dir appended as final argument

command.description: Slash command (type claude) or shell command line (type exec)

writes.description: Project-relative output files; '*' entries are globs (at least one match required, every match validated)

schema.description: Schema filename in creative-minds/schemas/ that the first output must satisfy

schemas.description: Optional per-write schema filenames, parallel to 'writes'; overrides 'schema'
